name: Cape of the Mountebank
description: A brilliant red cape with a scorched hem.
body:
## What it does

Once a day, as an action, you can vanish in a puff of smoke and reappear somewhere else, as the dimension door spell does. The smoke hangs where you were and where you arrive.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.note: you leave and arrive in a puff of smoke
